sessionStart.powershell: if (Get-Command recall -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { recall hook session-start --agent copilot }

userPromptSubmitted.powershell: if (Get-Command recall -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { recall hook prompt --agent copilot }

agentStop.powershell: if (Get-Command recall -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { recall hook stop --agent copilot }
